camera.observation_mode: One static vehicle-free global terrain RGB-D map of the UNDEFORMED surface (rigid-mesh proxy)

grid_index_order: grid[row, col] with row = y bin (increasing +y), col = x bin (increasing +x)
source: back-projected sensor pixels only; no authored heights
empty_cell_policy: z/range/sec are NaN and cover is 0; consumers must use the cover mask (scripts/sensor_dataset_v2.tensor12 marks such points invalid)
